name: Beijing
tagline: Where Ancient History Meets Modern Dentistry
intro: China's capital blends 3,000 years of history with world-class medical infrastructure. While you recover, walk the Great Wall, wander the Forbidden City and taste the city that invented Peking duck. Beijing is our flagship destination for international dental travellers who want culture and convenience in one trip.

highlights.name: The Forbidden City
highlights.description: The largest ancient wooden palace complex on Earth — 24 emperors called it home. A half-day walk through 600 years of imperial history.

highlights.name: The Great Wall
highlights.description: No trip to China is complete without standing on this wonder. The Mutianyu section offers fewer crowds and stunning mountain views.

highlights.name: Hutong & Courtyard Culture
highlights.description: Cycle or stroll the grey-brick alleyways, sip tea in a renovated siheyuan, and feel old Beijing's quiet rhythm.

highlights.name: Peking Duck & Imperial Cuisine
highlights.description: Crisp-skinned roast duck carved tableside — a culinary rite of passage paired with centuries-old recipes.

itinerary.title: Arrive & Settle
itinerary.description: Airport pickup, hotel check-in, light exploration of a nearby hutong.

itinerary.title: Consultation & First Treatment
itinerary.description: Clinic visit, 3D scan and start of treatment. Afternoon rest.

itinerary.title: Forbidden City & Tiananmen
itinerary.description: A guided morning through imperial history; gentle pace for recovery.

itinerary.title: Great Wall (Mutianyu)
itinerary.description: A breathtaking half-day at the wall, cable car up and down to save energy.

itinerary.title: Follow-up & Departure
itinerary.description: Final check, aftercare kit, and transfer to the airport.

medical.advantages: Beijing hosts some of China's most advanced dental hospitals and private clinics, with specialists trained internationally and equipment on par with any global capital. Our partner institution here offers implantology, cosmetic and general dentistry under one roof, with English-speaking coordinators for every visit.
